newsitem.title: USA: BT Office Q3 to come in below estimates.
newsitem.headline: BT Office Q3 to come in below estimates.

text.p: BT Office Products International Inc said Tuesday it expects its third quarter results to come in under Wall Street's estimates of between $0.12 and $0.13 per share.
However, the company said it expects results from the period to exceed the 1995 third quarter earnings of $0.07 per share.
BT Office attributed the projection to high operating expenses at the New York division and softness in the German market.

BT Office President and Chief Executive Rudolf Huyzer said in a statement that although the company has been successful in stabilizing its New York division, it has yet to see the benefits of cost-cutting measures.

"We expect to make further significant structural and process changes at the New York division to bring it up to the profitability levels of our other leading divisions," Huyzer said. "While we have not yet fully quantified the cost of these actions, it is likely that such expenses will be reflected in our fourth quarter results."
Huyzer added that the company intends to identify and deal with costs in the New York division as quickly as possible before the 1997 operating year.
The third quarter results are to be released October 22.
